name: Islam Khan Chishti
role: Subahdar associated with final consolidation in Bengal
contribution: He advanced administrative-military consolidation that reduced residual Baro-Bhuyans resistance and strengthened Mughal control from Dhaka.
context: His tenure represents the shift from contested campaigns to durable provincial governance.
impact: He is closely tied to the 17th-century completion of Mughal consolidation in Bengal.
highlight: A central figure in the transition from conquest to provincial consolidation.
